why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Connect a wallet on the dashboard Open the HeatRush dashboard and connect a supported Web3 wallet. From there you pick the action you want to take.

3 Step 3 : Keep building XP Staking in the ETH, USDC, BNB, BTCB and USDT markets builds XP, and the USDC, BNB, BTCB and USDT markets are described as qualifying for the upcoming HR Rewards Program. ETH stakers also move up through HeatRush tiers.
4 Step 4 : Invite friends with your referral code Connect your wallet on the referral page to generate your code. Each qualified referral gives 200 points and 2 XP.
5 Step 5 : Track your progress Return to the dashboard to see your XP, rewards and recent activity.
